title: Record the gate-operand agreement counts
body:
## Summary
- On six registers and source lists of length at most 4, the checker and exporter agree on all 4,686 destination-free gates and diverge on 3,492 gates.
- The checker accepts 1,230 gates. A simple-support guard admits 1,350 divergent gates. No selected-word scan and no new kappa.

## Test plan
- [x] `python3.12 -B research/gate-operand-agreement/verify.py`
